row: P89-TEXT-SIZE-EVERYWHERE part b try 2 (question box height)
screen: QAM page window 855x766 css px (external screen, not the Deck panel)
setup: Text size set via the plugin's own Settings row (RIGHT then A, focus label read before each A: 'Set text size to Normal' / 'Large' / 'Small'); each choice read back from the settings file key chat_text_size: normal, large, small. Original value small. Test text put in with deck_send_ask.py (VERIFIED each time).
pressed: RB/LB tab moves, RIGHT/LEFT on the Text size row, A on the named size button only. No A on the box. No LT/RT.
expected: Input height same on all three (about 44, within 0.5 of Normal), block about 74.6, fonts 12/13.8/10.8. On Large: two-line text about 59 and three-line about 73, same as Normal gives for the same text.
verdict_a_one_line_height: PASS - 43.99 px input and 74.56 px block at all three sizes (difference 0.00 from Normal).
verdict_c_multiline_matches_normal: UNCLEAR - the same text does not give the same height on Normal and Large, because bigger text wraps onto more lines. The 96-character sentence is 59 px (2 lines) on Normal and 73 px (3 lines) on Large. The doubled sentence is 88 px (4 lines) on Normal and 102 px (5 lines) on Large. Every value fits one rule (44 px plus 14.5 px per extra line), so one line costs the same on both sizes and the box does not change its one-line height. The runbook's 'about 59 and 73' for Large were met by 2-line and 3-line heights that Normal and Large produced with different text; a like-for-like 3-line case on Normal was not measured. Owner decides.
side_effect: Box was left holding the 'What is Hollow Knight' question text only until Ask was pressed for the smoke test (see END row); the box was empty afterwards. Text size is back to small.
